topic: Buying a fresh start: new shoes, a new gym, a new app or a new plan feel like change, but the habits come along with us; what has to change is how we show up, not the gear or the place
figure: Seneca (Moral Letters 28.1-2: you need a change of mind, not of climate; he recalls Socrates asking why someone was surprised travel did not help, since he took himself along wherever he went). Paraphrased, not quoted. Single quote page, at Mintra's request

lines: รองเท้าคู่ใหม่ ยิมใหม่ แผนใหม่
ไม่ได้พาวินัยมาให้เรา
ไม่ว่าจะไปซ้อมที่ไหน
เราก็พาตัวเองไปด้วยเสมอ
